narrative.headline: Agent fabricates deal data on pipeline reviews, undermining sales forecasting reliability.
narrative.detail: Users primarily request pipeline prioritization and analysis (15 of 52 traces), but the agent resolves only 1 of 15 such requests fully. Five of six documented failures involve hallucinated deal IDs, buyer quotes, and metrics absent from source data—critical for revenue forecasting. Users express confidence and optimism despite this unreliability. No risk trend data provided for this period.
narrative.top_action: Audit agent's data retrieval and validation logic for pipeline queries; add guardrails to prevent deal fabrication.
